mainHtml:
The year in the rearview mirror – Most sold, most bids on and most talked about

Featured cars
Whether you're selling your car or chasing your next dream car, the essence of auction is the same: anticipation, excitement and the will to win. Over the year, we've seen cars attract record bids, generate lively discussions and climb far above their reserve prices. Here, we've rounded up the stories behind the numbers – the auctions that really stood out.
Bidders HighwayDecember 22, 2025 14:00

Best-selling car brand of the year: BMW

BMW tops the list as the best-selling brand of the year on Bidders Highway. With its strong connection to driving pleasure, performance and a wide range of sought-after models, the brand has attracted both many bidders and quick deals – clear evidence of BMW's continued strength in the enthusiast market.


This year's best-selling car models: Ford Mustang, Porsche 944 and Chevrolet Corvette

This year’s best-selling models on Bidders Highway show a clear breadth of enthusiast interest. The Ford Mustang took first place and confirmed its position as a perennial crowd favorite. Shortly after, the Porsche 944 followed, a model that continues to win over both new and experienced enthusiasts. In third place was the Chevrolet Corvette – a clear sign that classic American performance is still strong in the auction market. In addition, a Corvette C3 sold for a European record, just under 700,000 SEK.


Most bids 2025: Volvo P1800 Custom

When it comes to engagement, one car stood out in 2025. A 1963 Volvo P1800 attracted the most bids of any auction on Bidders Highway and quickly became a rallying point for buyers and commentators alike. The combination of iconic design, strong recognition and the right audience created an intense bidding war – a whopping 122 bids collected by this custom build.


Most comments 2025: 2005 Lexus LS 430

Not all auctions are decided by bids alone. A 2005 Lexus LS 430 was the most commented item on Bidders Highway this year, turning the comments section into a lively forum for opinions, experiences and geeky details. When a car manages to get so many enthusiasts to want to have their say, you know it's hit the right spot.


Bid rocket of the year 🚀 - 1969 Ford Mustang Mach 1

Sometimes the market speaks with force. A 1969 Ford Mustang Mach 1 ended the year with the highest price above its reserve price, becoming a clear example of what happens when the right car meets the right audience. With rising bids and strong momentum, the auction really took off – and when the hammer fell, both seller and buyer were able to leave the deal with a smile.


This was just the beginning

In the closing days of the year, we will continue to look back at 2025 and share more interesting, unexpected and entertaining numbers from our auctions – along with our own personal favorites. Because behind every statistic there is a car, a story and an auction worth remembering. See you soon on Bidders Highway.

Don’t miss our series of articles that conclude a fantastic 2025, and also look into the future with all that it means. See you on the streets, at the meetings and in the auction section of our website!
//The Bidders Highway Team
